rules.name: Dockerfile Runs As Root
rules.recommendation: Set a non-root USER near the end of the Dockerfile so the container does not run as uid 0.

rules.name: Dockerfile ADD With Remote URL
rules.recommendation: ADD with a URL skips checksum verification and bloats layers. Use RUN curl + sha256sum or COPY for local artefacts.

rules.name: Dockerfile Floating Or Latest Tag
rules.recommendation: Pin base images to a specific tag or digest so builds are reproducible.

rules.name: Dockerfile Privileged Build Flag
rules.recommendation: Privileged or unconfined containers disable kernel isolation. Drop the flag and add only the capabilities you need.

rules.name: Dockerfile apt-get Without Cleanup
rules.recommendation: Combine apt-get install with --no-install-recommends and rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* in the same RUN to keep images small.

rules.name: Kubernetes Privileged Pod
rules.recommendation: Privileged or root containers can escape isolation. Set runAsNonRoot: true and drop ALL capabilities, allow only what's needed.

rules.name: Kubernetes Host Namespace Sharing
rules.recommendation: Sharing the host network or PID namespace lets a pod observe and attack other workloads. Remove unless strictly required.

rules.name: IAM Policy Wildcard Action And Resource
rules.recommendation: Action and Resource both set to '*' grants effectively-admin rights. Scope each statement to the verbs and ARNs it actually needs.

rules.name: Terraform Ingress Open To World
rules.recommendation: 0.0.0.0/0 ingress exposes the port to the entire internet. Restrict to known CIDRs or front with a load balancer / VPN.
